headline: Premier League MW8: Bournemouth stun Manchester United 3-0 at Old Trafford
whyCareReason: Bournemouth silenced Old Trafford with three unanswered goals, climbing to 13 points and leaving Manchester United languishing in mid-table.
teaser: FINAL: Manchester United 0, Bournemouth 3. Rayan 37', Tavernier 42', Christie 90+2'. Cherries claim famous away win.
story: AFC Bournemouth produced one of the most emphatic away performances in their history on Sunday, 25 October, cruising to a 3-0 victory over Manchester United at Old Trafford. The Cherries seized control before the interval when Rayan broke the deadlock in the 37th minute and Marcus Tavernier doubled the lead five minutes later. Ryan Christie sealed the points in stoppage time, condemning Erik ten Hag's side to their fourth league loss of the campaign (10 points) while Bournemouth vaulted up to sixth on 13 points.
stakes: Bournemouth rise to 13 points alongside Chelsea, while Manchester United fall to tenth position on 10 points.
rivalryAngle: Bournemouth record back-to-back dominant visits to Old Trafford in Premier League history.
funFacts: Scorers: Rayan 37', Marcus Tavernier 42', Ryan Christie 90+2'.
Bournemouth climb to 13 points (4-1-3) into the upper half of the table.
